q17.

`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

The module `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` defines the memo CRUD query/mutation hooks (`useMemos`, `useInfiniteMemos`, `useMemo`, `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, `useMemoComments`, etc.), all built on `@tanstack/react-query` and calling methods on `memoServiceClient` (imported from `web/src/connect.ts`), which is the Connect-generated client for `MemoService` (`web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`).
